categories.main_business_segments: The company operates two primary business segments: edible mushroom cultivation and bulk discount snack retail. The edible mushroom business focuses on factory-based production and sales of fresh mushrooms including enoki mushrooms, oyster mushrooms, and deer antler mushrooms. The bulk discount snack business, which expanded dramatically in 2023, operates retail chains selling packaged snacks and food products across multiple regions in China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: For edible mushrooms, the company employs factory-based cultivation using advanced automation and environmental control technologies, including liquid spawn technology for enoki mushroom production and standardized cultivation processes. The company utilizes agricultural byproducts (rice bran, corn cob, wheat bran) as cultivation substrates and implements mechanized, automated, and intelligent production systems. For snack retail, the company uses supply chain optimization, digital management systems, and standardized store operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The edible mushroom business primarily serves fresh produce distributors and food retailers across East China, South China, and Central China regions, with products distributed to approximately 20 provinces and municipalities. The bulk discount snack retail business targets individual consumers through direct retail stores and franchise partners, with operations across 16 provinces and municipalities including Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Shandong, Anhui, Henan, and others.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with two major production bases located in Zhangpu, Fujian and Nanjing, Jiangsu. The edible mushroom business distributes to East China, South China, Central China, Southwest China, Northwest China, North China, and Northeast China. The bulk discount snack retail business operates stores across 16 provinces and municipalities with 4,726 stores as of December 31, 2023.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates at multiple supply chain positions. In the edible mushroom business, it operates midstream as a producer and processor of fresh mushrooms, selling primarily through distributors and retailers. In the bulk discount snack retail business, it operates downstream as a retailer, purchasing products from manufacturers and distributors and selling directly to consumers through retail stores.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include developing new edible mushroom varieties through breeding and cultivation research, optimizing production processes to reduce costs, expanding the bulk discount snack retail network nationally, enhancing supply chain capabilities, improving logistics and warehousing infrastructure, strengthening brand building, and advancing digital transformation and refined management. R&D initiatives focus on enoki mushroom strain selection, oyster mushroom liquid spawn technology, and contamination control optimization.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through two primary models: product sales of fresh edible mushrooms to distributors and retailers on a wholesale basis, and retail sales of packaged snacks through direct-operated stores and franchise partner stores. The snack retail business also generates revenue through franchise fees and brand licensing. The company uses a buy-and-sell model for snacks, purchasing from manufacturers and selling at retail prices.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the edible mushroom industry, the company is positioned as a leading factory-based producer with daily production capacity of 393.5 tons, ranking among the top domestic competitors. The company holds certifications as a national agricultural industrialization leader and national seed industry revitalization enterprise. In the bulk discount snack retail sector, the company operates as a rapidly expanding regional leader with the 'Haoxianglai' brand, competing in a fragmented market with significant growth potential.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company experienced dramatic growth in 2023, with total operating revenue reaching 929.37 million yuan, representing a 1,592% increase from 54.93 million yuan in 2022. The bulk discount snack business revenue surged from 6.66 million yuan to 875.90 million yuan (13,058% growth), while edible mushroom revenue grew 10.78% to 534.71 million yuan. However, the company reported a net loss of 82.93 million yuan in 2023 due to high costs during the rapid expansion phase.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: For edible mushrooms, the company emphasizes factory-based production ensuring food safety, quality consistency, and environmental sustainability through standardized processes and advanced automation. The company differentiates through multiple mushroom varieties, high production capacity, and certifications including ISO9001, HACCP, and GAP standards. For bulk discount snacks, the company offers high-value-for-money products through supply chain efficiency, direct manufacturer relationships, extensive SKU variety (1,500+ items), and convenient neighborhood retail locations with pleasant shopping environments.
